content: Baame Apa Pyuo Yulu Pyuo Karenge Dokona Jopome Polo Leya

content.text: Nambame kinyi kinyi lalu lao lapala lamaiyuo,
Wanake dupwa kandapala kepo pyuo nyuo reto palipuli lao suu pyaa naro, leyo.
Anatu Porai Wakasa dokome namwa kando aki mende pirase?
Wambunya yulu koo pilyaminyi dupwana apa pyuo baame yano pyarase?
Wambu lapo koo pirami dupwa
baame randa andake maiyuo koo keta palyara.
Anatumi nambana yulu pilyu dupwape kata papilyu dupwape soo karamo.
Nambame yulu koo mendepe pipala wambu menge dupwa minyako pii nange lao
kingi ketae nembo leto.
Anatumi sikyali angi rolae mendena namba sikyali pipala
namba koo mendepe pali nalyamo doko kandara.
Namba kata keyange dokona yaki nyero ramo
panda yulu koo pinya wangu lakaro ramo
dee nambana kingi dokome koo piru ramo
dokopa nambana ee dupwa kokwa sinyi nembena lao
dee wambu lapo dupwame nambana nenge wara pingi dupwa manjo nena lareko.
Nambana parali maki palenge akali dokona enda doko auwapala nambapa palimbwali lao suu pyapala
enda banya anda kambu dokona yalu pyuo maa palyuo karapuli
dokopa nambana enda dokome akali wakale mende nenge maiyuo baapa palyuo pipyali.
Kepo yulu dopale dokome kanya pyapo lao kuma lao kyawa yaki nyasara.
Koo doko Satanena panda isareme rao karenge dopale ingyuo
nambana bange peparae rao pyalingi nyera.
Nambana kendemande dokona mendeme namba kando mumu laramo dokopa
nambame sepala mondo lao nyisaro.
Nambame dopa pii naro ramo doko Anatu kando apa larose?
Namba keta kote laramo dokopa aki pii larose?
Anatu mendaki namba wasiyamo dokomeko
nambana kendemande dupwa wasiya.
Nambame pendewa dupwa nyisalana maka suku suku nengende daa.
Enda waiya dupwa pee lombanyi karalyo sinya lapala kaengende daa.
Dee namba nenge napala dokopa muiyane dupwa lopome kumuo pena lapala kaengende daa.
Yuu gii peparae nambame nakama poraiyuo suu pyao rapu pyuo karenge.
Wambu muiyane mende komau yangyaramo dupwa nyelana
saka naramo kandaro ramo dokopa
komau rangena mena sipisipi yamanji wapusi keyange doko mairu.
Dokopa baame banya mona andarename peparae piso rae maiyuo nambana kingi minyalyara.
Nambame kote lao wini piroŋo lao sepala
wambu muiyane dupwa minyako piyuli
doko nambana kingi doko roo piyali
dee nambana lange dokona piso rekya lao yuku nyisa epeyali.
Renge doko namba Anatumi kote lara ingilyamo dokona soo paka renge ipyasa
namba yulu dopalepe mende kamame pii napuli lao suu pyao karo.
Namba isa bange kamongonge dupwana mona nyii nange
Nambana mena bangepe dee kana malupi retenge dupwana namba range mupwa lao suu pyaa nange.
Neta rao yanga paupau lenge dokona lao nambame neta doko lakandengende
panda kana rao kendapuli minyingi dokona lao kana doko lakandengende daa.
Namba nyuo isoko kata nembaramopa dupwa kingi lakando ketae pyambulyu lao
nambana kingi dupwana makando lapo pyuope pinginde daa.
Koo dopale dokome Anatu Porai Wakasa doko mata maipala kumuo randa nyingi.
Nambana nyisu petenge dupwa yasu nenge dokopa namba rae maiyuo karengende daa.
Dee nakama randa andake nyingi dokopa namba kapaŋa lao rae mainginde daa.
Nambame koo pyuo wambu dupwa kuminya lao ateŋa pyakami nange.
Akali nambana yulu pyakange dupwame
wambu upunili dupwa yuu peparae yako lao nenge pilyunu doko kandenge.
Wambu kata londe pena epenge dupwa katana palena lao kaeya napala
nambana anda yako lao nyuo palyingi.
Akali menge dupwame nakamana koo dupwa yalu pipala kaenge.
Dopa pilyaminyipape nambana koo dupwa pano polo lao karenge.
Namba wambumi mende larami dupwana paka nange.
Nakamana pii koo lao giyalya giyana pyuo larami dupwana pakapala
namba elya kalo andakare kara nange.
Namba pii leto dokona mendemepe aki letene lao see naramisi?
Pii peparae kinyiŋi lao lalu lao leto.
Anatu Porai Wakasa dokome isingi yano pyakana.
Nambana koo pingi dupwana lao nambana nyisu petenge dupwame yango palyuo minyuo eparaminyi dokopa
namba randa nyereŋe lao pepana pyasi sipyali
Dupwa peparae nyuo nambana lange dokona mona kare kare embo
kyawa rarange ingyuo kyawana pee pyuo wambu peparaeme kandena lao dupwa ketae minyalyapuli.
Nambame yulu pipunu dusipa peparae Anatu lamaipala
banya lenge kambu dokona namba enamba see napala karapuli.
Nambana ee nenge reto mena minyuo pilyunu yuu doko waa nyepala
wambu mendena wakalende nyepala dokona nenge ando karamo dupwa napala
yuu range pama yulu pingi akali doko mee lopo karena lapuli
dokopa witi jingipi bali jingi andenge doko suu pyao
yuu dokona mano jingipi rano pisi api pyapyali.

content: 32:1—37:24 Jopona puu minyingi akali andapae dupwame Jopo kando pii isingi lao karapala kaeyami dokopa akali parange mende kingi Eliyu lenge baame pii lamaiya. Eliyu baa akali andapae leyaminyili pyuo leyamopape baa Anatunya porai renge andake dokona lao polo lamaiya. Banya pii wambu dupwa yaka lapala rapa rapa pisi karo Anatumi pii andake enakana lao oteyamo doko kapa siyami.
